sources.label: AliExpress
sources.availability: International delivery; confirm final shipping, VAT, and delivery date at checkout.
sources.notes: Prefer official stores, 4.7+ seller rating, 100+ orders, and Buyer Protection. Avoid fake capacity drives.

sources.label: OLX private listings
sources.availability: Private seller; prioritize Blagoevgrad/nearby pickup and inspect before paying.
sources.notes: Never prepay a private seller. For electronics, inspect in person or use courier inspection; verify the exact model and test it.

sources.label: Temu
sources.availability: Browser-collected offers only; confirm final shipping, VAT, and returns at checkout.
sources.notes: Use only for low-risk accessories. Do not buy storage where capacity/authenticity matters without independent proof.

sources.label: Alibaba
sources.availability: Browser-collected offers only; verify MOQ, shipping, and Trade Assurance before buying.
sources.notes: Mostly wholesale. For a personal purchase, check MOQ, shipping, Trade Assurance, and whether the listing is actually retail.
